paragraphs: Rabbi Tzadok (Hyman reports Dikdukei Soferim’s reading R' Yitzchak) bar Chaluka: [Yoma 78a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.78a.12).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Yoma 78a reads רבי צדוק בן חקולא, Rabbi Tzadok ben Chakula. Hyman has bar Chaluka and reports Dikdukei Soferim’s Rabbi Yitzchak reading.

The linked Bavli has Rabbi Tzadok ben Chakula. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3020&lang=en) records the same account under Rabbi Tzadok ben Chaluka. Hyman has bar Chaluka and reports the variant R’ Yitzchak from Dikdukei Soferim.
